name: LLM-Generated Comprehensible Story Language Learning Tool

mentions.name: LLM-Generated Comprehensible Story Language Learning Tool
mentions.description: A language learning tool that uses LLMs to generate stories at the reader's ideal level, aiming for about 95% comprehensible text with the remaining 5% made up of new or still-learning words. Readers click on words they don't fully understand while reading. Development is currently Spanish-only to optimize per language, and includes database design, story validation, and an onboarding estimation system that gauges a user's existing knowledge.
mentions.problem: Language learners need reading material precisely matched to their comprehension level, and LLM output can't be blindly trusted (e.g., for grammar explanations), so generated stories require validation.
mentions.audience: Spanish language learners seeking stories calibrated to their level
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a language learning tool where it uses LLMs to generate stories at your ideal level. The idea is the user would be provided stories that are 95% comprehensible, with the other 5% being a mix of brand new words or words you are still learning.
